copilot-custom-provider.config.providers: Provider configurations stored in settings.json. Synced automatically across devices via VS Code Settings Sync. API keys are stored separately.
copilot-custom-provider.config.apiKeys.d: API keys for providers configured to use 'settings' storage. Keys are stored in plain text — prefer SecretStorage when possible.
copilot-custom-provider.config.visionMod: Model id used by the vision proxy when forwarding images to text-only providers. Leave empty to auto-pick.
copilot-custom-provider.config.visionPro: Prompt sent to the vision proxy model when describing image attachments.
copilot-custom-provider.config.debug.des: Enable verbose diagnostic logging in the output channel.
